first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, and we have durable evidence that simplification drives activation in SMB segments (memory_31, memory_86). I'm verifying memory_86 to confirm the specifics of how shortening onboarding improved completion rates, and memory_73 to understand the promotional pricing cohort pooling issue before we potentially need it as a backup. Simplify_onboarding is the highest-confidence play: it addresses an existing decline in our core funnel, aligns with our SMB strength, and has proven durable lift. It also avoids the revenue recognition and churn risks of aggressive discounting in a competitive market. A standard experiment this week can test streamlined signup/onboarding flows, measure time-to-first-action, and build optionality if results are strong. Enterprise sales assist and referral incentives are longer-term plays; activation messaging is secondary to the structural onboarding friction we're seeing.
